instruction: Enable the 'Use dynamic keyboard shortcuts' option in GIMP preferences.

metadata.explanation: Task requires enabling dynamic keyboard shortcuts via Edit > Preferences > Interface. The evaluator checks gimprc config file for '(can change-accels yes)' entry. Similar configuration task to the original.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter correctly extracts GIMP config file (gimprc) from the expected location (~/.config/GIMP/2.10/gimprc)
Metric check_config_status correctly parses gimprc format and checks for multi-word key '(can change-accels yes)'
Expected value semantically matches instruction: 'Use dynamic keyboard shortcuts' corresponds to '(can change-accels yes)' in gimprc
Postconfig appropriately closes GIMP (Ctrl+Q) to ensure settings are written to gimprc before verification
Complete coverage: evaluator verifies the only requirement in the instruction
